sources.decision_basis: The accountable maintainer approved bounded internal acquisition and retention on 2026-09-13. The official Medstat landing page currently describes aggregate annual sales statistics through 2025, and its reuse terms permit commercial and non-commercial reuse with Sundhedsdatastyrelsen and date attribution while requiring transformed figures to be identified. Acquire only source-generated aggregate result exports with exact recorded query parameters; do not acquire person-level records or publish source bytes or derived outputs.

The historic anonymous NorPD report service permits reuse with source attribution and is frozen with data through 2020. This does not authorize restricted person-level registry access or imply post-2020 coverage.

The accountable maintainer approved bounded internal acquisition and retention on 2026-09-29 for source-generated aggregate API results only. Record exact query parameters, retrieval time, source version, response digest, and attribution. Enforce the documented 70,000-cell and 100-ATC-code limits. Exclude person-level data, broad bulk downloads, public release, and external publication.
